title: Property inspections: original source editions, buyer workflow and complete customer receiving

task.name: Receive and operate the selected property report and inspection task
task.purpose: An authorized NYC portfolio operator obtains a dated building-condition report, reviews changed source conditions, chooses an existing RentCheck inspection template, completes the internal inspection and reopens its original report through the normal RentCheck/PMS workflow.
task.request: Continue the original RentCheck buyer Workshare and supporting Insparisk source inquiry. Select one actual buyer team/environment, up to 50 original NYC property records, up to three existing inspection templates, two authentic Propply source editions and one already supported report/PMS route. Retain the complete roster and explicit BBL/BIN/address and buyer property/template identities. Use the original Property source workspace to acquire the deliberately selected report, review its coverage and identity links, prepare the agreed inspection, reconcile its actual returned identity, and retain the complete report. Compare the later source edition and preserve changed, unchanged, null, missing and unavailable values separately. Retain unresolved identities and the buyer's disposition; do not infer a match from response order or an address similarity. Keep any paid resource request and receipt with the original seller and independent buyer state.
task.completeOutput: The selected merchant adapter and customer-specific identity/field mapping; the configured buyer inspection/report route; both complete source editions and selected comparison; original inspection and report identities; all selected property dispositions and customer examples; full versioned source/runtime/configuration instructions, original request histories and permitted result files; complete customer workspace export, independent reopen and returned acceptance. The original paid HPD development result remains a separate source.
task.repeatTrigger: A new source edition or changed agency status, the next scheduled inspection, lease turn, acquisition review or follow-up after corrective work. Buy only a report needed for that task.
task.pricedUnit: The merchant and independent buyer select the useful complete report/task and any resource payment separately from the proposed implementation fee. One inspection or later source task retains its original attempts and receipt. Ordinary API billing does not create a Stellar resource purchase. No purchase is required merely to increase a count.

source.reference: Select the actual Propply report edition and authorized account/host, the complete property roster, RentCheck account-specific contract and original template/property IDs, and the selected report/PMS route. Retain exact files and hashes in the original operating case.
source.population: The complete selected roster of at most 50 NYC properties and all their source/inspection dispositions; two authentic source editions; up to three existing templates; one buyer team/environment and one existing report/PMS route. The full selected source corpus remains available even when a paid resource exposes only selected fields.
source.meaning: Preserve BBL/BIN/address as supplied and explicit unmatched identities. Insparisk's composite grade differs from HPD violation Class A/B/C. Aggregate HPD counts do not provide individual violation IDs. Open is an agency-record status, not a claim that a physical condition remains uncorrected. Use exact authorized detail data when task-specific violation text is required, and retain missing/unchanged states. The demonstrated HPD Preservation project-participation data is a separate baseline: its project events/participation rows are not violations, unique properties or evidence of a physical condition. Mapping the newly selected Propply report into an inspection workflow is incremental customer-specific work.
source.changePolicy: Save a new retained customer selection for a corrected roster, identity, field projection, source/host agreement or later edition. Preserve every earlier selection and its original native request. Changed scope, another merchant, another receiving environment, new PMS implementation or extra source family follows the original Workshare change agreement. Source withdrawal affects future availability; it does not rewrite the record of a previously authorized task.

receiving.application: The complete maintained Property domain plus original Socrata browser/CLI, typed SDK, merchant MCP and Applications lifecycle; the buyer's actual entitled RentCheck environment and selected existing report/PMS route. Use the READY contribution and original 1FB3 receiving programme; a small source index does not substitute for the installed application.
receiving.acceptanceRule: All selected properties have matched or explicit unresolved identities; complete source/report bytes and dates are retained. Five customer-selected examples cover changed, unchanged and unavailable source data where present. The original operator creates and reopens the agreed internal inspection, its original returned ID and complete report; a repeated recovery request keeps that same action. Two authentic source editions remain separately available. A selected merchant resource payment is operated only for a real needed buyer task under the buyer's actual approved budget; complete output and its original receipt reopen independently. If conventional API billing is selected, retain its agreed billing and complete task result without requiring or counting an onchain purchase. A source condition never automatically certifies a property. The customer's original Installation Return records named observations against the exact saved edition. Property selections, evidence and explicit exceptions must cover the whole roster. Compiler findings do not establish buyer acceptance or any grant purchase qualification.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The merchant controls source entitlement, permitted fields, whole-body/report delivery rights, resource hosting and payment terms. The buyer controls its team, host, credentials, templates, resident-facing actions, receiving operator and any source spending. Credential values stay in the original private host; source files use references. Each party approves its actual scope.
receiving.recovery: Keep the original Property key, workspace identity, expected revision, issued status and native inspection ID. Recover a completed response before a new dispatch; uncertain creates remain issued until actual reconciliation. Export and restore the source workspace through its original complete format, retaining publisher and buyer state separately. The Installation return/import uses the existing saved edition, request, complete case archive and owner KEEP/APPLY decisions, preserving later owner edits.
receiving.maintenance: Name the merchant account/resource owner, buyer integration operator, receiving engineer, source/certificate maintainer and defect contact. Carry the original two consolidated reviews and 30-day delivered-software defect correction. Agree actual kickoff, staffing and access dependencies; preserve licences and separately assigned hosting/API/network charges.

steps.title: Select the complete customer task
steps.result: Freeze one 50-property roster, merchant licence/host, permitted report fields, buyer team/templates, priced resource and acceptance examples. Original planned delivery effort: 8 hours; retain the separate 16-hour in-scope contingency.

steps.title: Receive the merchant source
steps.result: Join the original Propply API to one merchant-owned report resource; preserve source metadata, complete pages, immutable editions and original paid-request/receipt recovery. Original planned delivery effort: 16 hours; retain the separate 16-hour in-scope contingency.

steps.title: Join the buyer inspection workflow
steps.result: Receive the complete report into the existing buyer review; explicitly match property identity and let the operator create an internal inspection with its original inspection_template_id. Original planned delivery effort: 20 hours; retain the separate 16-hour in-scope contingency.

steps.title: Receive and compare the later edition
steps.result: Compare a second authentic source edition, preserve unchanged/missing conditions, avoid duplicate inspection creation after an interrupted response and retain the original inspection/report relationship. Original planned delivery effort: 16 hours; retain the separate 16-hour in-scope contingency.

steps.title: Operate, export and reopen
steps.result: Configure one already-supported report/PMS route, export the complete selected evidence, and perform restart/reopen using the same original identities. Original planned delivery effort: 12 hours; retain the separate 16-hour in-scope contingency.

steps.title: Review and hand over
steps.result: Complete two review rounds, deliver editable source/configuration/guide and have a second authorized operator reopen the original selected case. Original planned delivery effort: 12 hours; retain the separate 16-hour in-scope contingency.

inputs: The full original cohort scope, existing commercial case/Workshare and commissioning packet, exact phase/effort source and native Installation seed; use the original case and current selected grant plan
One buyer team/environment and accountable buyer/merchant contacts; actual source licence, permitted report fields, host/redistribution/cache/export terms and dated approval sources
Complete original roster up to 50 properties, exact supplied BBL/BIN/address and buyer property identity; explicit match or unresolved basis for each
Up to three existing RentCheck template IDs, selected inspection requirement per property and one existing report/PMS route, all bound to the actual account contract
Two authentic source editions with original dates, complete response/coverage files, field-selected comparison and all unavailable or unmatched outcomes
Merchant/buyer host and named receiving operator; declared credential references and complete READY runtime/source selection
Five customer-selected acceptance examples and every property disposition; original inspection/report/request IDs and complete supporting source files
Separate professional implementation terms and source/resource payment selection; no inferred atomic price, payment, grant qualification or calendar
Original full source workspace, seller and buyer recovery products; independent receiving and original Installation Return/owner decisions
